prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve edit. Asset: production candidate for a Cocos 2D hand-drawn game sprite idle loop. Input 1 is the EXACT approved 08 thin-outline character master. Input 2 is the current same-character sheet, for identity only; REPLACE its fast twitchy breathing. Draw EXACTLY 24 chronological frames in a strict SIX COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid on 1536x1024. Each cell is256x256, each character about210px tall, both boot soles rest at localy240, centeraroundx128. No text, borders, floor or cast shadows. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA-ZERO background, not painted black or gradients. Opaque character interiors. Preserve the exact 08 muted tan, gray-olive, pale brown palette, shading, hand-drawn texture and moderately thin gray-brown outlines. CONSISTENT MODEL SHEET: copy the same proportions, face, head size, limb thickness, costume seams, belt, pockets, boots, marks and line thickness from frame to frame. All 24 drawings belong to ONE very slow relaxed breathing cycle, not 24 poses. Absolutely no crouching, walking, head bobbing, balance shifting, changing stance, rubber bending, shoulder rolling or body scaling. Both feet, knees, hips, wrists, head and gear have IDENTICAL positions and shapes in all frames. ONLY the upper chest contour beneath clothing and a small local cloth fold move by at most TWO PIXELS over the ENTIRE cycle. First sixframes slowlyinhale, nextsix reachthetop with ease-out, nextsix slowlyexhale, finalsixreturntoneutral with ease-in. Frame24almostequalsframe1 for a seamlessloop. Every adjacentpair differs by a subpixel-to-onepixel amount, no sudden change at rowboundaries. Do not independently redesign each drawing. Make crisp readable exact-cutout sprites. Hood, face, blade, backpack, both legs andarms remain absolutely fixed; show tiny chest/poncho breathing, no eyelid/face changes.
